title: Stabilize APK CI by provisioning debug signing keystore before assembleDebug
body:
The APK pipeline was failing before artifact upload, blocking direct mobile download. Root cause was missing `debug.keystore` while the app’s debug build is explicitly configured to sign with a local debug signing config.

- **Problem alignment**
  - Ensures CI can always produce an installable debug APK for mobile-first users without local build tooling.

- **Workflow hardening**
  - Added a dedicated keystore provisioning step in `.github/workflows/build-apk.yml` before Gradle build.
  - Keystore is generated only when absent, preserving idempotence across reruns/cached workspaces.
  - Uses Android-standard debug credentials (`android` / `androiddebugkey`) to match project signing config expectations.

- **Why this unblocks artifact publication**
  - `:app:assembleDebug` now passes signing validation, allowing downstream rename + artifact upload steps to execute.

```yaml
- name: Create debug keystore for CI signing
  run: |
    if [ ! -f debug.keystore ]; then
      keytool -genkeypair -v \
        -storetype PKCS12 \
        -keystore debug.keystore \
        -storepass android \
        -alias androiddebugkey \
        -keypass android \
        -keyalg RSA \
        -keysize 2048 \
        -validity 10000 \
        -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US"
    fi
```
